props.heading: From first plank to first sail.

steps.title: Book a place
steps.text: Choose a week and pay a deposit. Bursary places are free.

steps.title: Meet your group
steps.text: Monday morning in the boatshed: tools, safety and a cup of tea.

steps.title: Build your boat
steps.text: Three days of planking, fastening and fitting out, with a mentor beside you.

steps.title: Launch it
steps.text: On Friday the boats go in the water, and families come down to watch.
